reason: Refuted as a correctness defect, not as an observed mechanism: an independent Go 1.26.6 woven HTTP harness using all IAST defaults reproduced 2384 store rejections among 29805 sampled requests with at most two callers. However, the design explicitly allows store-contention losses independently of capacity exhaustion; no separate product-rule violation or leaked permit was established. The finder's default-max benchmark forces 100% rather than default 30% sampling. Go 1.27.0 reproduces through the API, but woven execution is blocked by the separate known JSON advice compile failure.
